correctness.rationale: For 0<u,v<1, t>1-u, r>1+v, the strict LRRR branch multiplier M=A_R^3 A_L has determinant -uv^3 and trace T=-rt(r²-2v)+(u-v)(r²-v). Exact fixed-point branch-coordinate numerators give D x0=-(r-v-1)(r²+(v-1)²) and D x2=-(r-v-1)((1+u)(1-v)-rt), where D=1-T-uv³. Schur stability gives D>0 and T>-1+uv³; x2>0 forces rt>(1+u)(1-v), yielding T<-1+uv³+2v(u-v) and hence u>v. Conversely for u>v, r0=1+v,t0=(1+u)(1-v)/(1+v) gives a strictly Schur-stable boundary double-contact with t0>1-u; setting r,t to boundary+epsilon opens strict LRRR and keeps stability. Exact expansion yields x0=-2(1+v²)epsilon/D0+O(epsilon²), x2=(r0+t0)epsilon²/D0+O(epsilon³), and the other points tend positive. Reconstructed M/coordinate formulas independently with symbolic algebra plus rational u=3/4,v=1/4 witness; finite witnesses do not prove all-real necessity.
